mapper.select: SELECT u.first_name, u.last_name, c.content, c.comment_id_1 AS idParentComment, c.comment_id AS idComment, c.timestamp_ FROM comment_ c INNER JOIN user_ u ON u.cip = c.sender_cip WHERE c.item_id = #{id} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment_(timestamp_, content, updated_at, comment_id_1, item_id, sender_cip) VALUES (NOW(), #{comment.content}, null, #{comment.idParent}, #{id}, #{cip});
mapper.update: UPDATE comment_ set deleted_at = now() where comment_id = #{id}
